findings: The packaged AOT app loads send_airplay2.dll with its OpenSSL and Botan DLLs inside the AppContainer.
The built-in Credential Manager store is unusable inside the AppContainer at runtime: removing an absent profile and loading an existing profile both report credential_store.
Pairing into a C# PasswordVault host store works (first hardware pairing into a host store); the credential survived two in-place package updates.
Brokered StorageFile reads serve the receiver.

With privateNetworkClientServer only, casting fails on a Public network (start reports connection after about the 5 s request timeout; inbound traffic from the receiver is blocked) and works on a Private network.
internetClientServer makes casting work on a Public network.

The native DLLs are linked against the desktop C runtime; they loaded because the desktop runtime is installed system-wide. A UWP-correct native build must target the app C runtime (part of D49 step 3).
not_run: Provisioning the app's locker from a desktop process.
receiver_side_effect: One new Apple TV pairing entry for the living-room-uwp controller identity.
